description: Gives an agent what it needs to advise on a website's lead capture: a snapshot of the website's widgets (kind, live or draft, views, completions, conversion), the six widget kinds with where each appears, and the steps to follow — read the site, ask the user questions with offer_choice, then rank 3-5 fixes. It fetches no pages and changes nothing. Suited to "what should I do on my site" or "audit my site". Scoped to the current website; pass `project` to pick another.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.

name: plan_site_strategy
title: Plan site strategy
